limitations.title: Apple Silicon only
limitations.description: Vela V1 supports arm64 Apple Silicon Macs and does not ship an Intel or Universal binary.

limitations.title: macOS 15 or later
limitations.description: Vela V1 requires macOS 15 or later.

limitations.title: TUN can conflict with another active VPN
limitations.description: Simultaneous network tunnels can compete for routes or DNS ownership depending on the other VPN configuration.
limitations.workaround: Stop the other VPN before enabling Vela TUN, or use Vela System Proxy mode.

limitations.title: Subscriptions must provide complete Mihomo YAML
limitations.description: Vela does not convert provider-specific or partial subscription formats into a complete Mihomo configuration.
limitations.workaround: Import a complete Mihomo YAML document from a trusted source.

limitations.title: No automatic App downgrade
limitations.description: Vela does not silently install an older App over a newer data schema.
limitations.workaround: Use the documented backup, export, last known-good official installer, and recovery flow before a manual downgrade.

limitations.title: Factory Core is pinned to Mihomo v1.19.29
limitations.description: The immutable Factory fallback remains Mihomo v1.19.29 for the V1 release line.
limitations.workaround: Use a compatible, unblocked Core supplied through the signed Vela Core Catalog when one is available.

limitations.title: SSID matching is not enabled for automatic Scenes in this RC
limitations.description: Production Scenes and non-SSID automatic evaluation are enabled. Wi-Fi SSID evaluation remains unavailable, and the Location usage description is reserved for that gated path.

limitations.title: Diagnostics are not uploaded automatically
limitations.description: Vela keeps crash and support evidence local until the user explicitly exports and shares a redacted Support Bundle.

limitations.title: Beta and RC builds are prerelease software
limitations.description: A Beta or RC may contain unresolved non-Stop-Ship regressions and receives best-effort support.
limitations.workaround: Keep a current backup and, if available, retain your last known-good official installer; use Stable for production-critical networking.
